methodology: financials (revenue/income) are gross per game day (24 turns) in ANCHOR units, converted x USD anchor rate for display. balanceSheet (market cap/cash/debt) is in HOME-CURRENCY units, converted via live forex. marginPct = operatingIncome / totalRevenue * 100. growth = split-adjusted tape change over trailing 30 turns (game 6M uses internal snapshots; figures converge for steady traders). Threshold checks run on USD market cap. BANKRUPTCY: the engine exposes no bankruptcy flag - terminal insolvency is a hard delete of the corporation document, so a bankrupt corp simply stops resolving and is recorded here as alive:false + dissolved:true with its last-verified figures frozen and lastSeenTurn recorded. Corps still trading but approaching default are flagged distressed:true from bonds[].defaulted or negative cashOnHand. Dissolved corps are excluded from all alliance sums and charts until they reappear.
